verdict.rationale: Supermemory exposes a documented REST API (OpenAPI 3.1 spec) with search/retrieve endpoints that return JSON, and self-hosting lets the whole engine run on your own hardware, both of which reduce lock-in indirectly. However there is no documented bulk-export feature, export format, or explicit data-portability tooling in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: a dedicated export/backup API or CLI, documentation describing export formats, and independent confirmation that a full data dump is possible.
